question: Who won India’s only gold medal in women’s freestyle wrestling at the Asian Wrestling Championships, 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manisha Bhanwala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manisha Bhanwala** secured the solitary **gold medal** for India in the **women’s freestyle wrestling** category at the **Asian Wrestling Championships 2025**.
 
• She competed in the **65 kg** weight division and delivered a dominant performance throughout the tournament to reach the top of the podium.
 
• The **Asian Wrestling Championships 2025** was held in **Amman, Jordan**, during **April 2025**, featuring elite wrestlers from across the continent including powerhouses like **Japan** and **Kyrgyzstan**.
 
• Her victory is a significant milestone as she was the only Indian woman to clinch a **gold medal** in this edition, highlighting her rising status in the **international wrestling** circuit.
 
• This achievement adds to India’s overall medal tally, where the team also secured various **silver** and **bronze** medals in other categories and weight classes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Vinesh Phogat**:
 
 
• She is one of India's most decorated wrestlers, having won multiple **Commonwealth Games gold medals** and an **Asian Games gold**.
 
• Traditionally competing in the **50 kg** or **53 kg** categories, she has been a trailblazer for women's wrestling in **India** for over a decade.
 
 
 
• **Antim Panghal**:
 
 
• She made history by becoming the first Indian woman to win **back-to-back U20 World Championships** titles in **2022** and **2023**.
 
• She competes in the **53 kg** weight class and is considered one of the strongest contenders for **Olympic** and **World Championship** medals.
 
 
 
• **Reetika Hooda**:
 
 
• She achieved fame by becoming the **first Indian woman** to win the **U23 World Wrestling Championship** gold medal in **2023**.
 
• She competes in the **76 kg** heavy-weight category and has shown exceptional progress in **senior-level** continental tournaments.
 
 
 
• **Asian Wrestling Championships**:
 
 
• This is an annual event organized by **United World Wrestling (UWW)**, the international governing body for the sport.
 
• The tournament serves as a crucial platform for athletes to earn **ranking points**, which determine seeding for major events like the **World Championships** and the **Olympic Games**.
 
• India has consistently performed well in this event, particularly in the **freestyle** and **Greco-Roman** disciplines.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Manisha Bhanwala**'s journey includes significant success at the **U23** and **Junior** levels before transitioning successfully into the **senior** international arena.
 
• Her **gold medal** win in **2025** is crucial for India’s wrestling landscape, especially as the sport undergoes transition and focuses on developing new talent for the **2028 Los Angeles Olympics**.
 
• The **65 kg** category is known for being highly competitive in **Asia**, making her victory over top-seeded athletes from **Central Asia** and **East Asia** a remarkable feat of technical skill and endurance.
